chunks: The Sheikh (may Allah the Exalted support him) informed me, from Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmud, from al-Ridha (peace be upon him) — he [Ibrahim] said: I heard him say:
In istinja, what is apparent on the anus shall be washed, and the fingertip shall not be inserted into it.

key_terms.اَلِاسْتِنْجَاءِ: istinja — ritual cleansing of the private parts after relieving oneself

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ridha (AS) rule concerning the correct method of istinja in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a legal ruling from Imam al-Ridha (AS) on istinja (ritual cleansing after answering the call of nature), relayed through a chain culminating in Sheikh al-Mufid and Sheikh al-Tusi. The Imam stipulates that only the externally visible surface of the anus needs to be washed and that inserting the fingertip inside is prohibited, thereby defining the minimum boundary for valid ritual purification.
